name: Skill Loan Scheme
benefit:
1. The maximum loan limit under the Scheme has been enhanced from ₹1,50,000 to ₹7,50,000.
1. The minimum and maximum loan limit under the Scheme are ₹5,000 and ₹7,50,000 respectively.
1. The loan is provided without any collateral security and/or third-party guarantee.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be an Indian national. 1. The applicant should have secured admission to a skill training course. 1. The applicant should meet the minimum qualification criteria required to undergo the skill training course. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF) aligned courses and/or Non-NSQF-aligned courses offered by training entities onboarded on the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship’s Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) platform. 1. The applicant should be admitted to a course run by: - Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs). - Polytechnics. - Schools recognised by Central or State Education Boards. - Colleges affiliated with recognised universities. - Training partners affiliated with the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC). - Sector Skill Councils. - State Skill Mission. - State Skill Corporation.
